x-e-h3-06.thinking.0: Yanke shawara ko bayanin ya isa
x-e-h3-06.title: Ɗaliban da suke cin karin kumallo suna samun maki mafi girma: me kuma muke buƙatar sani?
x-e-h3-06.goal: Ka tantance ko sakamakon binciken yana nuna “dalili”, zaɓi ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata don wannan hukuncin, sannan ka ba da shawara da Turanci kan hanyar kwatantawa don gwada tasirin abincin rana kyauta.
x-e-h3-06.material:
Wannan ikirari ne daga labarin makaranta: “Ɗaliban da suke cin karin kumallo suna samun maki mafi girma a jarabawa, saboda haka makarantar ya kamata ta ba da karin kumallo kyauta.” A matsayin shaida, an gabatar da sakamakon binciken ɗalibai 200 kamar haka.

Rukuni | Yawan ɗalibai | Matsakaicin maki
Ɗaliban da suke cin karin kumallo | 130 | 82
Ɗaliban da suke tsallake karin kumallo | 70 | 74
x-e-h3-06.thinking.1: Gane ƙarin bayanin da zai taimaka
x-e-h3-06.prereq.1: Ƙwarewar rubuta jimlar shawarwari mai sauƙi da Turanci (Ka ba ... ga ..., sannan ka kwatanta ...)
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ne ake buƙata don tantance ƙarshe cewa “karin kumallo kyauta a makaranta yana ƙara maki”? Zaɓi duk waɗanda suka dace.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.hint.0: Duba ko kowane bayani yana taimakawa wajen amsa tambayar, “Shin alaƙar karin kumallo da maki dalili ce?”
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin dalili guda da zai sa ƙarshe ya zama kuskure, sannan ka nemo bayanin da zai gwada shi.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.r.a: Wannan ƙima ce da za ka iya ƙididdigewa daga matsakaicin rukuni biyun tuni, ba ta faɗi dalilin bambancin maki ba.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tambaya ce da ke bincika ko akwai wasu bambance-bambance banda cin karin kumallo da za su iya shafar maki.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tambaya ce da ke neman yanayin da aka gwada dalilin kai tsaye.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.r.d: Ana buƙatar farashi yayin yanke shawarar aiwatarwa, amma ba shaida ba ce kan ko yana ƙara maki.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.r.e: Domin kwatanta maki, dole ne a auna su bisa ma’auni iri ɗaya.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.explain: b na bincika wasu dalilai (barci, lokacin karatu), c na bincika sakamakon gwajin shiga tsakani na gaske, e kuma na bincika adalcin kwatantawar. a da d ba shaidar cewa abinci yana ƙara maki ba ne.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.prompt: Wane ƙarshe ne ya fi dacewa a faɗa daga teburin kaɗai?
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bambanta abin da lambobin teburin suka nuna da fassarar dalilin.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.hint.1: Idan jimlar ƙarshe ta ƙunshi “saboda” ko “idan ... to ...”, duba ko teburin ma ya nuna hakan.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.o.a: Matsakaicin maki na ɗaliban da suke cin karin kumallo ya fi na waɗanda ba sa ci.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya faɗi gaskiyar da teburin ya nuna kawai, ya bar batun dalili a buɗe.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.o.b: Idan aka fara ba da karin kumallo kyauta a makaranta, matsakaicin maki zai tashi.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.r.b: Teburin ya kwatanta ɗaliban da suke cin karin kumallo da waɗanda ba sa ci kawai, bai nuna sakamakon samar da karin kumallo ba.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.o.c: Karin kumallo ba shi da alaƙa da maki.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.r.c: Fadin cewa babu alaƙa alhali teburin ya nuna bambanci bai dace da teburin ba.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.o.d: Yawan ɗaliban makaranta masu cin karin kumallo idan ya ƙaru, matsakaicin maki na makarantar ma zai ƙaru.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.r.d: Teburin ba shi da bayanai na makarantu daban-daban. Sakamakon kwatanta rukuni biyu ne a wannan makarantar guda.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.explain: Teburin ya nuna bambancin matsakaicin maki tsakanin rukuni biyun ne kawai, bai tabbatar da dalili ba. Don magana kan dalili, ana buƙatar ƙarin bayani da zai kawar da wasu yiwuwar bayani.
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.prompt: Ta yaya za ka kwatanta don gwada ko karin kumallo kyauta yana ƙara maki? Ba da shawararka cikin jimlolin Turanci ɗaya ko biyu. Ka guji raunin kwatantawar teburin (ɗaliban da suke ci da waɗanda ba sa ci na iya bambanta ta wasu hanyoyi banda abincin).
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin wata hanya da rukuni biyun teburin suka iya bambanta banda karin kumallo.
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda za a yanke shawarar waɗanda za su samu abincin don kada wannan bambancin ya faru.
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Don gwada wannan, za mu iya ...
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A hanyar da ka tsara, ɗaliban da suka samu abincin da waɗanda ba su samu ba (ko kafin da bayan fara ba da abincin) sun yi kama sosai da za a kwatanta su?
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: A bayyane yake waɗanne rukunoni ko lokuta kake kwatanta makinsu?
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.modelNote.0: Ya kafa rukuni kwatantawa ta zaɓen bazuwar.
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ya yi amfani da kwatanta kafin da bayan cin karin kumallo tare da yanayi daga wasu makarantu.

x-e-h3-03.title: Abu guda ya faru, kanun labarai biyu: hukunci yana canjawa yayin da bayanai ke ƙaruwa
x-e-h3-03.topic: son zuciya da firam: kanun labarai
x-e-h3-03.goal: Yayin da bayanai ke ƙaruwa, sake duba yadda salon kanun labari da bayanan da ya bari suke karkatar da shi zuwa gefe idan aka kwatanta da gaskiya, sannan ka bayyana wani abu guda da Turanci.
x-e-h3-03.material: Za a bayyana labarin da ya shafi majalisar birni tana yanke shawarar ƙara kuɗin ajiye mota kusa da tashar a matakai. Ka lura ko hukuncinka zai canja yayin da bayanai ke ƙaruwa.
x-e-h3-03.thinking.0: Fahimtar tasirin zaɓin kalmomi da bayanan da aka bari
x-e-h3-03.prereq.0: Kwarewar karanta kanun labarai na Turanci
x-e-h3-03.prereq.1: Furucin kuɗi mai sauƙi a won (KRW)
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.prompt: Za a bayyana kanun da abin da ke cikin labarin a hankali. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci mafi dacewa bisa bayanin da kake da shi zuwa lokacin.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ware kalmomin kanun da ke ba da gaskiya daga waɗanda ke nuna ji.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko kwatanta ko sabon bayani yana canja hukuncinka na baya.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Kanun labari: “Majalisa ta Watsa Direbobi da Ƙarin Kuɗin 50 Percent Kusa da Tasha” (slap: bugawa da tafin hannu, hike: babban ƙarin farashi)
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wane ra'ayi wannan kanun ke ba mai karatu?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.after: An ɗora kalmar hukunci kamar 'slaps' a kan gaskiya (kuɗin zai ƙaru). A yanzu ka gane ra'ayin da yake bayarwa kawai.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Yana kama da kanun da ke ba da gaskiya ba tare da ƙarin ra'ayi ba, domin yana da lamba (50 Percent)
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ko da lambar daidai ce, kalma kamar “slaps” tana haifar da ra'ayi.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Yana nuna kamar majalisa ta ƙara kuɗin a hankali cikin kulawa
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: “Slaps” ba kalma ce ta kulawa ko tausasawa ba; tana sa a yi tunanin bugun mutum da ƙarfi.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Yana sa a ji cewa ana hukunta direbobi ba bisa adalci ba
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: “Slaps” da “hike” suna haifar da ra'ayin cewa direbobi ne waɗanda aka zalunta.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Sakin layi na farko na labarin: Kuɗin ajiye mota na awa ɗaya zai tashi daga 1,000 won zuwa 1,500 won, karuwar farko cikin shekaru 12. Kuri'ar majalisa ta kasance 5 da 4.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Wane kimantawa ne ya fi dacewa da 'ƙarin kuɗi 50 percent' da 'slaps' a kanun?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Lambar daidai ce. Amma kalmar 'slaps' da barin mahallin cewa ba a ƙara kuɗin cikin shekaru 12 sun karkatar da ra'ayi zuwa gefe.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Tun da lambar daidai ce, wannan kanun labari ne marar son kai da ke ba da gaskiya kawai.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ko da lambar daidai ce, zaɓin kalmomi da barin bayani na iya canja ra'ayi.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Lambar daidai ce, amma kalmar “slaps” da barin 'ƙarin farko cikin shekaru 12' suna haifar da ra'ayi mai karkata.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne da ya tantance gaskiya sannan ya kimanta salo da bayanin da aka bari dabam.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Lambar kanta ba daidai ba ce, saboda haka kanun ƙarya ne kuma babu buƙatar tattauna son kai.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ƙarin daga 1,000 zuwa 1,500 da gaske 50 percent ne. Wannan shi ne sakamakon kiran wani abu ƙarya ba tare da duba lambar ba.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Daga baya a labarin: Za a yi amfani da ƙarin kuɗin wajen sabbin hanyoyin bas guda biyu. Birnin maƙwabta yana cajin 2,000 won a awa. Mambobin majalisa huɗu da suka ƙi sun ce ƙarin ya yi yawa.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Bisa bayanan da aka sani zuwa yanzu, wane sabon kanun labari ne ya fi adalci?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kanun adalci yana amfani da tabbatattun bayanai kawai kuma yana barin kalmomin hukunci. Akwai kanun irin wannan da dama, kuma ra'ayi yana ɗan bambanta bisa bayanan da ka zaɓa. Sauran mahallin yana cikin rubutun labarin.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kalmar hukunci “wisely” tana haifar da ra'ayi mai kyau, kuma an bar ra'ayoyin masu adawa.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Yana ƙunshe da tabbatattun bayanai kawai (kuri'a, adadi) kuma yana barin kalmomin hukunci.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: “Furious” yana ƙirƙirar ji da ba a tabbatar da shi a labarin ba, sannan ya jingina shi.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Yana amfani da tabbatattun bayanai kawai ba tare da kalmar hukunci ba. An bar sakamakon kuri'a da ra'ayoyin adawa, amma zaɓi ne karɓaɓɓe na kanun labari.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.info: Ra'ayin mai karatu: “Kowane kanun yana barin wani abu, saboda haka babu kanun adalci.”
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.ask: Wace amsa ce ta fi dacewa da wannan ra'ayi?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.after: Ba za a iya guje wa barin bayani ba. Saboda haka maimakon 'mai son kai ko a'a', ya fi amfani a kwatanta 'wane zaɓi ya fi karkata'.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Daidai ne a wani ɓangare. Ba za a guji barin bayani ba, amma wasu zaɓuɓɓuka sun fi karkata zuwa gefe guda.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya gane cewa ba za a guji barin bayani ba, kuma matakan karkata suna bambanta.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Gaskiya ne. Saboda haka kowane kanun yana da son kai iri ɗaya.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.r.b: “Duka suna barin bayani, don haka duka iri ɗaya ne” ƙarshe ce da ta daina kwatantawa.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Ƙarya ne. Idan aka rubuta lambobi da ranaku kawai, kanun ba ya barin komai.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Zaɓar gaskiyar da za a haɗa ma zaɓi ne, saboda haka barin bayani yana faruwa.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.reflect: Da ka ga kanun farko ka iya fahimtar ra'ayin kawai; bayan duba gaskiya sai ka iya tantance lambobi da salo dabam. Idan sabon bayani ya zo, ka sake duba hukuncin 'kanun yana da son kai' ta hanyar ware lambobi, kalmomi da bayanin da aka bari.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi kalma ko bayanin da aka bari guda ɗaya da ke sa kanun farko (Council Slaps Drivers ...) ya karkata zuwa gefe, sannan ka bayyana da Turanci.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi kalma guda a kanun da ke nuna ji.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta a jimla ɗaya yadda ra'ayin mai karatu zai canja idan an cire kalmar.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana cewa kalma ko abin da aka bari yana canja 'ra'ayi', ba gaskiya ba?
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Idan ka zaɓi bayanin da aka bari, ka rubuta takamaimai abin da aka bari?
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Yana nuna kalmar da kuma bayanin da aka bari.

x-e-h3-08.title: Imel ga malami don neman ƙarin lokacin miƙa aiki
x-e-h3-08.goal: Nemo kalmomin da ke sa saƙon farko ya yi kama da umarni, ka sake rubuta shi a matsayin imel mai ladabi zuwa ga malami, sannan ka yi hasashen ma’anar ɓoye a amsar.
x-e-h3-08.material: Ranar miƙa rubutunka Juma’a ce, amma kana son miƙa shi bayan kwana biyu saboda atisayen bikin makaranta. Wannan saƙon farko ne da ɗalibi ya rubuta don aika wa malamin Turanci, Mista Lee.
x-e-h3-08.thinking.0: Tantance irin tasirin da salo ke bayarwa
x-e-h3-08.thinking.2: Fahimtar ma’anar ɓoye a jimlolin kaikaice
x-e-h3-08.prereq.0: Kalmomin imel na asali kamar Dear ~ da Thank you
x-e-h3-08.prereq.1: Ka taɓa ganin roƙo da aka yi da could da would?
x-e-h3-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda da malami zai iya ɗauka a matsayin “umarni, ba roƙo ba”. (Ko da layuka biyu ko fiye sun dace, guda ɗaya kawai za ka zaɓa.)
x-e-h3-08.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta kowane layi, ka duba ko zai yi kama da umarni (“yi shi”) ga ɗayan maimakon roƙo (“don Allah ka yi shi”).
x-e-h3-08.s.s1.hint.1: Wane layi za a iya sauya zuwa “Could you ...?” ba tare da canza ma’anar ba?
x-e-h3-08.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 (“Give me ...”) da na 4 (“Reply today.”) an rubuta su cikin umarni, kamar ana ba malami umarni. “Hey” a layi na 1 da “Bye” a layi na 5 salon abokai ne, abin takaici, amma manufar wannan tambayar ita ce nemo layukan da suke kama da umarni.
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.prompt: Sake rubuta saƙon farko da Turanci a matsayin imel mai ladabi zuwa ga malami. Ka haɗa gaisuwa, roƙo mai laushi, dalili, da godiya.
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo yadda za a mayar da jimlolin umarni a saƙon farko zuwa tambayoyi ko jimlolin sharaɗi.
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.hint.1: Yanke shawarar jerin imel ɗin (gaisuwa – roƙo – dalili – godiya), sannan ka rubuta sashi ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka mayar da jimlar roƙon zuwa tambaya ko jimlar zato maimakon “Give me”?
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka tabbatar dalilin ya bayyana yanayin ne ba ya zama uzuri?
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ya ƙunshi roƙon da aka yi a sigar tambaya da godiya.
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.prompt: Mista Lee ya ba da amsa kamar haka: “To, amma ina fatan wannan ba zai zama al’ada ba.” Wane abu ne ya fi dacewa a fahimta daga amsar?
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.hint.0: Karanta farkon ɓangare da ƙarshen ɓangaren amsar dabam, ka duba abin da kowanne ya faɗa.
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunani kan bambancin jimlar da ta fara da “hope” da umarni kai tsaye.
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.r.a: Ka haɗa fahimtar “To” (an amince) da “fatan ... ba zai zama al’ada ba” (burin kada a maimaita).
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.r.b: Wataƙila ka rasa kalmar “To” ka karanta gargaɗin da ya biyo baya kawai.
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.r.c: Babu furuci kai tsaye da ke nuna fushi. Wannan fassara ce da ta ɗora masa motsin rai fiye da yadda aka faɗa.
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.explain: Amsar ta amince da roƙon, amma tana ɗauke da ma’anar ɓoye cewa kada a maimaita. Irin wannan tsokaci ba ya ce kai tsaye “kada a sake nan gaba”, amma a hankali yana bayyana tsammani.

x-e-h3-01.title: Shaidar editan jarida ta kai har zuwa ƙarshe da ya yanke?
x-e-h3-01.goal: A cikin gajeren editan jarida na Turanci, nemo wurin da alaƙar shaida da ƙarshe ta karye, sannan ka sake rubuta jimlar ta dace da zangon da shaida take goyon baya.
x-e-h3-01.material: Wannan wani ɓangare ne na editan jarida ta yankin. Kowace jimla tana da lamba.
x-e-h3-01.thinking.0: Bincika iyakar abin da shaida take nunawa.
x-e-h3-01.thinking.1: Sake fasalta ƙarshe domin ya dace da zangon shaidar.
x-e-h3-01.prereq.0: Gwaninta na bambance iƙirari da dalilai a gajeren rubutu na Turanci.
x-e-h3-01.prereq.1: Furucin lambobi mai sauƙi kamar kaso da “9 cikin 10”.
x-e-h3-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda da ya ƙunshi wurin da shaidar marubucin ba ta goyi bayan ƙarshe sosai ba. (Ko da akwai layuka biyu ko fiye, zaɓi guda ɗaya kawai.)
x-e-h3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, yi alama ga abin da marubucin “ya bincika kai tsaye” da abin da marubucin “ya yi iƙirari kawai”.
x-e-h3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane layi, kwatanta waɗanda aka tambaya a zahiri a binciken da waɗanda ƙarshe yake magana a kansu.
x-e-h3-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 sakamakon tambayar abokan ciniki 10 a cafe guda kawai ne, amma layi na 4 ya faɗaɗa wannan zuwa “mafi yawan mazauna”. Layi na 5 buƙata ce da aka gina bisa wannan faɗaɗa ƙarshe. Matsalar ita ce ba mu san ko mutanen da aka bincika suna wakiltar duk garin ba; saboda haka ko ka zaɓi layi na 3 (zangon shaida), layi na 4 (ƙarshe da aka faɗaɗa), ko layi na 5 (buƙatar da ta dogara da wannan ƙarshe), ka lura da jerin alaƙar nan.
x-e-h3-01.s.s2.prompt: Sake rubuta layi na 4 da Turanci. Ka faɗi abin da shaidar marubucin kawai ta nuna.
x-e-h3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko yanke shawarar abin da za a canja a jimlar. Ƙungiyar ce, adadi, ko ƙarshe?
x-e-h3-01.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta jimla guda mai ma'anar 'shaida ta nuna mana har zuwa ... kawai.'
x-e-h3-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Jimlarka tana magana game da wa? Ƙungiya ɗaya ce da aka tambaya a shaidar?
x-e-h3-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Maimakon rage ƙarshe kawai, ka kiyaye matsayin marubuci (hana motoci) kuma ka ba da shawarar ƙara wasu shaidu?
x-e-h3-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ya rage faɗin ƙarshe kuma ya ba da shawarar mataki na gaba.

x-e-h3-02.title: Kalmomin da za a iya tantancewa da kalmomin da ke jan zuciya a jawabi
x-e-h3-02.topic: Jawabi: bambance shaida da jan zuciya
x-e-h3-02.goal: A jawabin ɗan takarar majalisar ɗalibai, ware bayanin da za a iya tantancewa daga jan zuciya, sannan ka tantance ko ya amsa ra'ayin akasin nasa.
x-e-h3-02.material:
Wannan wani sashe ne na jawabin Mina, 'yar takarar majalisar ɗalibai mai alƙawarin gina sabon ɗakin karatu.

x-e-h3-09.s.s1.explain: b da e suna da ladabi kuma sun bayyana yanayin (an yi oda minti 40 da suka wuce) da roƙon (a duba don Allah) a sarari. a ba ta da ladabi, c ba ta bayyana ba, d kuma ba ta da roƙo.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.prompt: Lokacin da aka tambayi ma’aikacin gidan kofi “Could you make my coffee right now?”, ya amsa “I’m afraid the machine is being cleaned until three.” Wane fahimta ce ta fi dacewa daga wannan amsar?
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.hint.0: Duba yadda bayanin amsar (ana tsaftace na’urar, har zuwa ƙarfe uku) ya shafi roƙon a yi yanzu.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ware abin da ma’aikacin ya faɗa da abin da ka ƙara zato.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.r.a: Ya ɗauki “ba yanzu ba” a faɗaɗe kamar “ba kowane lokaci ba”.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.r.b: Ma’aikacin bai taɓa cewa za su yi shi da 3 ba. An karanta wani alkawari da ba a faɗa ba cikin maganarsa.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.r.c: An fahimci ma’anar da aka nuna cewa yin yanzu yana da wuya, da kuma yiwuwar ƙin yarda ba na har abada ba ne.
x-e-h3-09.s.s2.explain: Ma’aikacin ya bayar da dalilin da ya sa ba zai yiwu yanzu ba kawai. Mataki na gaba shi ne a sake tambaya cikin ladabi game da lokacin da zai yiwu.
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.prompt: Bayyana da jimlolin Turanci 1-2 dalilin da ya sa zaɓi c a tambaya ta 1 yake da rauni duk da cewa yana kama da ladabi.
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.hint.0: Karanta c ka gani ko ma’aikacin zai iya gano abin da yake bukatar yi.
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.hint.1: Duba yadda kalmomi kamar “maybe,” “possibly,” da “probably nothing” suke sauya ƙarfin buƙata.
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Bayyaninka ya ce “ba a fahimci buƙatar ba” maimakon “ladabi ne matsalar”?
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka yi tunanin abin da za ka yi idan kai ne ma’aikacin da ya ji wannan jimla?
x-e-h3-09.s.s3.modelNote.1: Irin wannan bayani ne da aka faɗa da kalmomi dabam-dabam.

x-e-h3-10.title: Saƙo inda ba a iya gane wace ce “she”.
x-e-h3-10.goal: Nemo jimla a saƙon rukuni da za a iya fahimta ta hanyoyi biyu, sake rubuta ta yadda kowace ma’ana za a iya fahimta ta hanya guda kawai, sannan ka yanke hukunci lokacin da rashin fayyacewar ba matsala ba ne.
x-e-h3-10.material: Waɗannan saƙonni ne daga tattaunawar rukuni don shirya bikin kimiyya. Kowace jimla tana da lamba.
x-e-h3-10.thinking.0: Nemo jimlolin da ba su da ma’ana guda takamaimai.
x-e-h3-10.thinking.2: Yanke hukunci kan tsananin matsalar bisa yanayin.
x-e-h3-10.prereq.0: Yadda ake amfani da wakilan suna na Turanci (she, her).
x-e-h3-10.prereq.1: Jimlolin magana da aka ruwaito (She told me that ...).
x-e-h3-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda da masu karatu dabam-dabam za su iya fahimta ta hanyoyi dabam.
x-e-h3-10.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane layi, bincika ko za ka iya fayyace “waye yake yin me” a matsayin abu guda.
x-e-h3-10.s.s1.hint.1: A layukan da ke da wakilin suna, ƙirga mutane nawa wakilin zai iya nufi.
x-e-h3-10.s.s1.explain: “She” a layi na 2 na iya nufin Ms. Han ko Ms. Seo. Saboda haka ana iya fahimta ta hanyoyi biyu game da wace ce za ta yi rajistar zauren. Sauran layukan za a iya fahimtar wanda zai yi me ta hanya guda kawai.
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta ma’anonin biyu da layi na 2 zai iya yi da Turanci, kowannensu a matsayin jimla da za a iya fahimta ta hanya guda kawai. (Rubuta jimloli biyu.)
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta dabam yanayin da “she” take nufin Ms. Han da wanda take nufin Ms. Seo.
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.hint.1: Idan aka yi amfani da alamun zance kamar ana ɗauko maganar kai tsaye maimakon wakilin suna, zai bayyana wanda yake magana.
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Ms. Han told Ms. Seo, “...”
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mutum da ya karanta kowace jimlarka biyu zai iya fahimtarta ta hanya guda kawai?
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Jimlar ta kasance ta halitta ba tare da amfani da wakilin suna ba?
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Maimakon zance kai tsaye, an fayyace ta ta maimaita suna da amfani da wakilin suna na komawa ga kai.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.prompt: A wane yanayi aika jimlar asali (Ms. Han told Ms. Seo that she had to book the hall.) yadda take ba zai zama babbar matsala ba?
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.hint.0: Ka yi tunani ko masu karatu za su iya sani daga wani wuri dabam da wannan saƙo wace ce ke yin rajista.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.hint.1: Wane sharadi ne masu karatu dole su cika domin rashin fayyacewar ya jawo illa?
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.o.a: Lokacin aika saƙo a tattaunawar rukuni da mutane da yawa suke karantawa da sauri.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.r.a: Yayin da masu karatu suke ƙaruwa kuma suke karantawa da sauri, yiwuwar rashin fahimta tana ƙaruwa.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.o.b: Idan an saka alamar motsin rai a ƙarshen jimla.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.r.b: Alamar rubutu ba za ta iya canza wanda wakilin suna yake nufi ba.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.o.c: Idan kowa ya riga ya san wanda zai yi rajista.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.r.c: Wannan yanayi ne da bayanin da ke cikin halin da ake ciki yake warware rashin fayyacewar maimakon gyaran rubutu.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.explain: Rashin fayyacewa matsala ce a cikin rubutun kansa, amma idan masu karatu sun riga sun san bayanin, illar ta ragu. Dole ne a gyara shi ga masu karatu da yawa da ba su da wannan bayani.
